title: Static ooRexx API compatibility inventory and diff
summary: Inventory class, method, attribute, routine and ::requires directives in two independently supplied source trees, reporting removals without asserting runtime ABI.
invariants: The tool detects static directives only; it does not execute the interpreter, inspect native registration or prove inheritance behaviour.
Class/method names are compared case-insensitively; private/protected methods are excluded from the reported public-surface candidate.
Removed public static signatures are a strict compatibility gate; additions alone do not prove a compatible implementation.
Never infer Alchemy independence from absence of ::requires; inspect native linkage and install dependencies separately.
procedure: Use packages/oorexx-dbus-qualification/tools/api_inventory.py on the historical source tree.
Run on the candidate source tree with --compare-to path/to/historical --strict.
Review diagnostics/duplicate entries; verify C++ registered methods and dynamic class effects manually.
Only promote after actual ooRexx interpreter, native ABI and bus roundtrip qualification.
